name: Triceps Extension Machine
how_to:
Step 1: Adjust the Machine
- Select an appropriate weight that allows controlled movement without sacrificing form.
- Adjust the seat height so that your upper arms rest comfortably on the pad and elbows align with the machine’s pivot point.
Step 2: Setup and Positioning
- Sit upright with your back firmly against the pad and feet flat on the floor.
- Grip the handles in a neutral position with your palms facing your body.
- Ensure your elbows are aligned with the machine’s axis to optimize movement efficiency.
Step 3: Execution
- Push the handles downward, extending your arms fully while contracting the triceps.
- Hold the contraction for a second at the bottom of the movement.
- Slowly return to the starting position, controlling the weight as you bend your elbows.
- Repeat for the desired reps, keeping your movements smooth and controlled.
